Includes expatriate/historical residents, not just citizens. No name-based nationality prediction, no inferred popularity ranks.

sources.name: Wikidata — observed people/name counts (not population ranks)
sources.attribution: Wikidata contributors (2026), CC0 structured facts. Explicit human, given/family name, observed gender and citizenship/birthplace/residence facts. Count DISTINCT person IDs after spelling normalization. Biased public-person corpus, not a census; no equivalent national-rank claim. Ties use competition ranks.
